Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we can size Dedicated properly and validate against your SLOs.

Recap (from today's call):
- Target P95 latency for streaming chat: <= 250ms per token for user-facing requests (avg prompt size ~40 tokens, responses ~120 tokens).
- Sustained throughput target: 150 tokens/sec overall during peak business hours (with bursts to 400 tokens/sec).
- Concurrent active sessions to support: ~120 (typical), up to 300 in burst windows.
- Streaming required: yes — we need <200ms first-byte for streaming start and continuous chunking.
- Model family: prefer open LLM variants (LlamaX-70B quantized) but open to alternatives if needed for latency.
- Security note: data must stay within us-east; VPC/private deployment desired for Prod.

Attachments: I'm attaching a short Dedicated_Capacity_Validation_Plan.pdf with the validation steps, test harness we recommend, and initial pass at the GPU-comparison matrix. Can you confirm the latency/throughput targets above and share any additional constraints (e.g., max cost target, hard concurrency caps, or required GPU vendors)?

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm targets and any cost ceiling by EOD Friday.
2) Our SEs (cc'd Rafael) will build a quick benchmark recipe and run a 2-hour smoke test on a reserved pool.
3) We'll produce a sizing recommendation (GPU types, reserved throughput) and an estimated monthly cost for Dedicated.

If it's helpful I can loop in Aditya (solutions eng) to do a deeper GPU comparison — Rafael and I think we should evaluate A100 80GB (fp16), H100 (sparse kernel), and an Ampere/entry Migrate option (for cost-sensitive workloads).

Thanks — talk soon.

Thanks for the context. Quick readout / plan from SE side:

Summary recommendations (initial):
- H100 (sparse kernels / faster transformer paths) — best P95 latency for LlamaX-70B quantized: expect ~120-180ms P95 token latency at 150 tps sustained with streaming enabled (1ms token decode optimized). Reserved throughput per machine: ~40-60 tokens/sec for interactive workloads (depends on sequence length); so we'd reserve 3-4 H100 workers to hit 150 tps with headroom for bursts.
- A100 80GB (fp16) — strong performer: expect ~160-240ms P95 at 150 tps. Reserved throughput per A100: ~35-50 tps; plan for 4-5 A100s.
- Cost-optimized option (8xT4 / mixed Ampere instances with quantized kernels) — significantly cheaper but higher latency: P95 ~300-500ms at 150 tps. Reserved throughput per cluster-node: 10-20 tps; plan for ~10 nodes to hit baseline. Not recommended for hard 250ms P95.

Streaming notes:
- We'll use chunk sizes of ~64 tokens with a first-byte priority path to meet <=200ms first-byte.
- KV-cache sharding and continuous batching will be enabled; this reduces per-token cost but we must tune batch windows to avoid violating P95.

Proposed benchmark harness (we will upload to the shared Drive):
- 3 phases: warmup (15m low-concurrency), baseline (60m at 120 concurrent sessions, average prompt/response sizes you've given), stress (45m ramp to 300 concurrent with burst patterns to 400 tps).
- Metrics collected: P50/P95/P99 latency (first-byte and per-token), tokens/sec, GPU utilization, memory pressure, and cost estimate (per-hour).

Deliverables & timeline:
- We'll run smoke tests Mon/Tue (17/18 Jul) on staging pool. Raw results + gpu-sizing-table.xlsx + benchmark_summary.png uploaded to the Drive link by EOD Tue.
- Engineering will recommend a primary config (performance) and a secondary config (cost-optimized) with estimated monthly infra cost and recommended reserved throughput.

Questions / caveats:
- If Acme needs deterministic token latency at P99 we should also look at overprovisioning factors or autoscale buffers — that increases cost.
- For SOC2/KMS we need to confirm key rotation window and any HSM requirements; Rafael can own the compliance checklist.

I'll schedule the runs and post updates to the HubSpot deal.
